feedback: Evidence: iterations 0 to 2 all ended off_track with max_error of about 0.061 m. Iteration 1 (12 mm, x = ±0.05 m) removed line loss on the oval and slalom, so coverage was the line-loss cause. Iteration 2 (16 mm, same span, kp 3.5) left max_error at 0.061 m on every track. Raising kp from 3.0 to 3.5 also left max_error unchanged, so steering gain is not what sets the excursion, and the controller is not the limit here. I am testing your y = 0.06 look-ahead with the same footprint and span; the controller adds a small integral term to see whether a fixed motor mismatch causes the steady offset. The result of this race is not known yet. If max_error still sits at about 0.061 m with line loss at zero, the look-ahead is not the lever, so try wheel_track near 0.15 m for more turning authority. If line loss returns at y = 0.06, hold y = 0.04 and revert the look-ahead.
requested_changes: Keep 16 mm footprints at x = ±0.05 m and test y = 0.06, and report whether max_error moves below about 0.058 m.
If max_error stays at about 0.061 m at y = 0.06, try wheel_track 0.15 m (more turning authority) with the same sensors, since kp changes did not move the excursion.
If line_loss_events return at y = 0.06, revert to y = 0.04 and keep the 16 mm, ±0.05 m row.
